mentions.name: Hobbybot
mentions.description: This site uses AI to track pre-owned items for sale, starting with watches. It began as an OpenClaw agent searching for specific items the builder wanted to buy and was expanded into a full site to share with others.
mentions.audience: Others interested in tracking pre-owned items for sale, starting with watches
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to see how far I can get using AI to help me track pre-owned items for sale, starting with watches. I started with an OpenClaw agent that was looking for specific things I wanted to buy, and then I figured might as well make a whole site for it so I can share with others.
